note: OpenAPI type mapping: user Schema types named like builtins (Date, Decimal, Uuid, StatusCode, ...) keep their $ref unless qualified with the external crate; naive date-times / times (NaiveDateTime, PrimitiveDateTime, sea-orm DateTime, NaiveTime, time::Time) drop the offset-requiring date-time / time format; unit structs are {type: null}; Option<()> is a single null type; u8..u64 get minimum 0 (and u8/u16/u32 maximum); unknown types and unresolved generic parameters are {} (any) instead of {type: object}
